note: First-floor attic room (reached up the café staircase): adjectives of state 3 (ready, free, sick, fresh, clumsy...). Adjectives have no gender (divider null). The staircase on the left goes DOWN to the café; the doorway at the back right leads on into the robot workshop. The wooden market crate in the middle opens a zoom (R_adj_state_04_z1); it is not an exit.

clumsy waiter tripping with a tray of cakes
wild shaggy cat hissing at a toaster
toy bus packed with geese, one more goose waiting
granny knitting a scarf that never ends
